question: If the complete source-authorized owner packet is admitted without changing PAH-001, does it supply exactly the antecedents needed for full compact-time local-correlation convergence in the registered j-before-n order?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001 and its original finite stationary PH/LK/AP/TR dynamics.
fixed_scope.state: Original labelled Gibbs state and normalization only.
fixed_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time on each finite interval [0,T].
fixed_scope.order: j tends to infinity at fixed n first, then anchored n.
fixed_scope.target: The R-512 minimal closed-form semigroup at the declared scope.
fixed_scope.forbidden: No rate, function, state, carrier, regulator, direct-sum, counterterm, physical-time or limit-order change.

required_packet_fields.meaning: versioned signer, provenance, SHA-256 and non-post-hoc owner authority
root labels, multiplicities, duplicate-transition and invalid-move/root-measure convention
finite measurable spaces, target H, domain and measure-compatible U_n or equivalent path map
local-cylinder stabilization and norm/inner-product recovery with explicit N(f)
arbitrary-sequence weak liminf plus compatible limsup/recovery for target-form vectors
compact-time boundary escape/non-explosion for the unchanged unbounded generator
identification with the R-512 minimal closed form
fixed-n j-to-infinity residual estimate for every declared local cylinder pair
anchored-n target defect D_n tending to zero for the same declared domain
primary, independent, hostile and Lean manifests for the model-specific packet

formal_consequence.packet_complete: All required_packet_fields are source-authorized, hash-pinned and jointly compatible with the unchanged model.
formal_consequence.error_budget: For every declared local f,g and T, 0<=err(n,j;f,g,T)<=J(n,j;f,g,T)+D(n;f,g,T).
formal_consequence.fixed_n: For each n and epsilon>0, J(n,j)<epsilon/2 eventually as j increases.
formal_consequence.anchored_n: For each epsilon>0, D(n)<epsilon/2 eventually as n increases.
formal_consequence.conclusion: For every epsilon>0 there is N such that each n>=N has a J(n) with err(n,j)<epsilon for all j>=J(n), uniformly on [0,T].

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only a complete source-authorized packet plus all four verification roles can instantiate the formal consequence.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Any missing or researcher-owned field rejects admission; radial-only evidence is not full-domain evidence.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Only an exact unchanged-source contradiction in the packet consequence qualifies; packet absence is not a universal no-go theorem.

next_single_question: Can a versioned source-authorized packet satisfy all ten fields simultaneously while preserving the exact PAH-001 source bytes and j-before-n order?
non_claims: This contract does not supply the owner packet or prove any PAH-specific J/D estimate.
It does not prove full semigroup convergence, an infinite-volume process or a continuum limit until the packet is admitted.
It makes no physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass-gap or TOE claim.
External Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping and is not quantum, proper or Lorentzian time.
